title: A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27978v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines one-day-ahead forecasting of the S&P 500 closing level using a 2006-2025 dataset that includes fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features. We benchmark three model families, namely linear regression, vanilla recurrent neural networks (RNN), and long short-term memory networks (LSTM), within a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline. A central contribution of this work is a methodological audit of common practices in the deep-learning-for-stock-prediction literature. We identify three sources of result inflation that frequently appear in published methodologies: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, the absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting. translated_title: 一种用于标普500预测的线性回归、RNN与LSTM的方法学严谨基准测试：识别金融深度学习中性能虚高的来源
translated_abstract: 本研究使用2006至2025年的数据集（包含基础价格数据、宏观经济指标以及工程化技术特征）对标普500收盘价进行次日预测。我们在统一的预处理和时间顺序评估流程下，对三个模型族进行了基准测试，即线性回归、原生循环神经网络（RNN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）。本工作的核心贡献是对股票预测深度学习文献中常见做法进行的一次方法学审计。我们识别出已发表方法中频繁出现的三种结果虚高来源：使用小波去噪的评估目标、缺失朴素持续性基线，以及最优N次重复报告。随后，我们在针对上述每一项进行控制的修正协议下重新评估了所有模型族。性能采用均方根误差、平均绝对百分比误差以及……进行报告（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文通过方法学审计识别出金融深度学习股票预测文献中导致性能虚高的三种来源（小波去噪评估目标、缺失朴素持续性基线、最优N次重复报告），并在修正后的严格协议下对标普500预测的线性回归、RNN和LSTM进行了统一基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a methodological audit identifying three sources of performance inflation in the financial deep learning stock-prediction literature—wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, missing naive persistence baselines, and best-of-N replicate reporting—and rigorously benchmarks linear regression, RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 forecasting under a corrected protocol.
